Every entry MUST carry a full attribution — subsystem, cause, introducedAt, class — or tests/lint/testRatchet.test.js refuses it. Every entry MUST also carry a `magnitude` array: a banked row freezes its EXISTENCE, and the magnitude is what freezes its SIZE, so the population behind a permitted red cannot grow invisibly (ODQ 854, TE-RATCHET-MAG). `--update` can only REMOVE entries and LOWER magnitude ceilings; adding one is a deliberate, attributed hand edit.
